title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc — 2023 regulations
claims: The regulation states: 'UTMB Group organizes the HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc in collaboration with the Trailers du Mont Blanc association and the support of the municipalities'.
The same regulation describes the UTMB race as around 171 km with about 10,000 m of elevation gain, starting in Chamonix with a 46:30 finish limit.
The same regulation describes CCC as around 101 km and about 6,100 m, TDS as around 145 km and about 9,100 m, and OCC as around 56 km and about 3,500 m.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 UTMB 官网 2023 规则页全文，仅用于确认 HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc 的组织方与赛事规模，不用于 Mont-Blanc Marathon 的任何数据。
